chipSemantics.outputRate: Configured host outputrate. Host frame spans clock/rate inputclocks and duration-weighted integrates heldDAC levels, splitting at timer expiries. No clock/72 or fixednative sample_rate formula. -ffp-contract=off preserves separate doubleoperations.
chipSemantics.fifo: Two threeentry FIFOs,16-bit entries. Full push discards oldest. Register4 pushes both. tick consumesleftthenright; empty holds lastDAC. Invalid routes0/3 consume withoutlatch. RightFIFO can overwrite sameDAC afterleft ifboth route there.
chipSemantics.readRoutingTimer: Reads0 control,1 originalmaskedcycle register,2/3 FIFOempty4000/full8000,4 bitwiseAND flags,otherFFFF. Control low2bits routeleftFIFO(1left/2right),bits2..3 routerightFIFO(1right/2left). control/cyclewrite configuretimer; zeroeffectivecycle4095,cycle1inactive; active means control&15 nonzero. Active timer reconfigure clearsFIFOs/timerTick,untilTick=cycle-1,retainsDAC andinterruptCount. cadencebits8..11,zero16; interrupts counted notSH2delivery.
chipSemantics.outputModes: Defaultstandalone DAC uses12bit width/2048-1 withgain.4. Duty mode width/(cycle-or4095)*2-1 andgain1 usedPlaygroundPlayback/AnalyzerMAME defaults. No analogfilter; rawduty values may exceedfullscale. UninitializedDAC silent. Muted outputs zero but timers/FIFOs advance.
chipSemantics.state: RawC ABI memcpy ofsizeofState includingC++ABIpaddings; FIFOvalidcountchecked but no lengthargument/pointer guards. State excludesclock/rate/gain/duty/mute and storescontrol/cycles,FIFOs,DACvalid/values,timerTick,interruptCount,untilTick. Same-WASMbuild continuation only,notportable/native-crossABI snapshot. Publicfrozen opaque WeakMap token samewrapperinstance; resetrewindsState while configuration/mute staycurrent.
chipSemantics.wrapper: Owned generateStereo copies. Borrowed generateStereoView returns exactframes-length cachedviews, latergeneration/growth/disposal invalidates. reserveprewarms0..128, refreshViews invalidatesheapcache. renderInto fillsvalidatedoutputspan via scratch. LiveFIFOproxy reflectsactualC++ arrays. assertOpen guards publiccontrols/disposal.

reports.method: Actual generated JS/WASM through unchanged PWM32X async factory/wrapper, exact owned/borrowed/renderInto stereo PCM and semantic native state. Bounded positive controls also compare retained synchronous JS reference. Actual GenesisAudioEngine with explicit paired MAME PWM and real current FM/PSG, actual VgmPlayer checkpoint/opaque/seek. No mock, tolerance, Mixer or audio device.
limits: PWM render integrates held DAC/duty output over double-precision timer durations at the configured output rate. All16routing modes,3-word FIFO overflow dropping oldest, pending words, manual ticks, cycle0/1/extremes, active rewrites, all16interrupt cadences, valid clock/rate setters, gain and mute are checked. InterruptCount is a software observation, not an invented IRQ hook.

Current State is a72-byte wasm32 C++ memcpy struct including padding and inactive FIFO storage. Only decoded semantic fields and active FIFO words are compared, plus exact rendered PCM. There is no claim of portable raw byte format or deterministic padding. Trusted raw cross-loads are bounded to these exact builds/configurations. Only FIFO-size rejection is tested with malformed raw data; no null/length/arbitrary phase fuzzing.

Clock/rate/gain/outputMode/mute are intentionally outside native and public opaque state and remain current on reset/load. Public tokens are same-instance only. Constructor validation is distinct from permissive existing property setters; invalid runtime clock/rate values are not passed because they can make rendering unsafe.

Borrowed views are requested-length cached scratch objects and valid only until reuse/growth/disposal. The irregular main path alternates immediate borrowed copies and caller-owned renderInto spans. Owned arrays are retained directly through overwrite, capacity growth, real WASM heap growth and disposal. Reserved1..128 scratch renders are proven allocation-free.

Genesis default remains approximate legacy SimplePwm. The existing explicit mame path uses PWM32X; this checker supplies the paired actual WASM chip through the Engine PWM endpoint while retaining real current FM/PSG and production0.9/0.35/1 mix. Active FM reset-to-power-on equality is not asserted because YM reset retains free-running timing; same-phase opaque continuation is used.

Real VgmPlayer fixtures exercise packed b2 writes and original bank3 PWM samples through0x90..0x94 forward/loop/reverse/stop streams, actual checkpoint/seek and same-instance opaque Player state. Internal Engine source calls and Player delivered frames are not added twice.
No Browser/Worklet scheduling, Native backend, physical hardware or listening judgement is tested.
